documentation_improvement.exact_delta_text:
Proposed addition to docs/skills/repository-operations.md, beside OAuth generated-content admission:

The build-source guard must stop on failed or timed-out acquisition, invalid UTF-8, blank bodies, or payloads that lack mapping `oauth2Config.providers`. Validate both retrieved inputs before atomically replacing the generated module, retain the original strings unchanged, and preserve the previous module on failure. Capture acquisition diagnostics without exposing raw provider configuration or credentials. These checks qualify acquisition and structural shape only; they do not establish an approved source revision, supported provider policy, or actual OAuth behavior. Keep those release gates on hold until the owner identifies the authoritative pair. Do not replace unavailable input with a guessed repository, provider stub, successful skip, or disabled-provider policy.
documentation_improvement.remaining_uncertainty: Authoritative source pair/owner/revision and enabled/disabled/provider functional contract await user/sourceowner clarification; actual OAuth/platform/release still HOLD.
documentation_improvement.stale_or_ambiguous_guidance_removed: Avoid making future authoritative-source manifest/mode ownership block already implementable checked failure handling; distinguish shape from provider/release policy.

meaningful_tests_required: Nonzero first with valid stdout aborts second and preserves original destination.
Nonzero second preserves old destination; timeout/missing executable/decode failure preserve destination.
Zero-exit blank/whitespace, YAMLnull/scalar/list/APIerror, missing/wrong-typed oauth2Config/providers all reject.
Valid documented/test shape accepted with exact original LF/CRLF bytes and existing string structure. Synthetic fixtures do not become release source.
Failed temp write/replace preserves prior bytes and primary error; removes only owned temp; successful single atomic replacement includes both original strings.
Assertions distinguish guard shape from provider behavior and release authority; no stub/skip/provider invention or endpoint/clientSecret guessing.
not_accepted_as_current_requirement: Mandatory new source manifest selecting exactlytwo immutable path/digest pairs before implementing proven guard.
New acquisition modes requiring a nonexistent approved local pair now.
Speculative rejection or qualification of intentionally disabled provider maps.
Consumer-field completeness rules that ignore existing defaults or placeholder development templates.

smallest_implementation_now.acquisition: Capture binary stdout and private stderr, use check=True plus finite timeout; stop at first failure before second call. Public error identifies input/failure class/exit status without raw stdout/stderr or environment.
smallest_implementation_now.commit: Validate both complete inputs first; construct full module in memory; same-directory owned temporary write then os.replace. Prior module survives acquisition/validation/write/replace failure. Cleanup only owned temp; original error remains primary.
smallest_implementation_now.future_owner_work: After authoritative pair/revision and provider policy arrive, separately design immutable inputs/provenance and explicit release/canary/recovery admissions using original checkpoints.
smallest_implementation_now.owning_existing_branch: PR307; retain prior changelog history and normal target refresh
smallest_implementation_now.payload: Strict UTF-8; reject empty/whitespace body; safe YAML; require root mapping, oauth2Config mapping and providers mapping; reject API errors/null/scalars/lists/wrong shape. Preserve exact decoded strings.
smallest_implementation_now.provider_policy: Do not guess nonempty-provider requirement, allowlist, clientSecret requirement, pin or enabled/disabled policy. Empty provider maps are at most structurally shaped and must not gain full release/behavior acceptance pending owner policy.
smallest_implementation_now.scope_control: Prefer a small helper in existing build task or build-system module with focused tests. No manifest modes, generated workflow rearchitecture or new publication admission now.
smallest_implementation_now.source_selection: Keep configured repository/paths unchanged while authority clarification is pending; no new pair/provider/disabling choice.

source_recovery_limits: Existing immutable release-source task still needs separate admission/refresh; new helper cannot relabel historical artifact/source as repaired.
